files_measured: src/libregexp.c (3448 lines) compiled alone with -I src (headers: libregexp.h, libregexp-opcode.h, libunicode.h, cutils.h, list.h). It is the whole engine (parser + bytecode compiler + backtracking VM) but NOT self-contained: it references libunicode.c (case folding, CharRange set ops, \p{} property tables) and cutils.c (DynBuf growable buffer, UTF-8 decode, rqsort). Those two TUs measured separately with the same flags: libunicode.c Cortex-M4 text=49046 (M0+ 49176, x86-64 55170+456 data; 30600 of it is retained after --gc-sections when linked with libregexp, 6734 if the \p{} lookups are stubbed), cutils.c text=2079 (1747 retained). CONFIG_ALL_UNICODE is #defined unconditionally in libunicode.h:35, so -DCONFIG_ALL_UNICODE produced a byte-identical object. TEST/DUMP_REOP/DUMP_EXEC undefined -> no dump/test code in the object. Nothing excluded from libregexp.c.

User-supplied hooks that MUST be provided: lre_realloc (every heap allocation goes through it, realloc-style; no static-buffer mode), lre_check_stack_overflow, lre_check_timeout. From libunicode.c: cr_free cr_init cr_invert cr_op1 cr_realloc cr_regexp_canonicalize lre_canonicalize lre_ctype_bits lre_is_id_continue lre_is_id_start lre_is_space_non_ascii unicode_general_category unicode_prop unicode_script unicode_sequence_prop. From cutils.c: dbuf_init2 dbuf_claim dbuf_put dbuf_free __dbuf_putc __dbuf_put_u16 __dbuf_put_u32 pstrcpy rqsort unicode_from_utf8 unicode_to_utf8. No setjmp, no printf at runtime except vsnprintf in re_parse_error (formatted compile-error messages), which on newlib pulls svfprintf+vfiprintf+dtoa+mprec+malloc (~28 KB; link experiment A 75781 vs C 23748 B).
ram_model: Heap REQUIRED through lre_realloc: compile builds the bytecode in a growable DynBuf (tens to a few hundred bytes for typical patterns; header 8 B + ~3-10 B per atom; the caller owns/free()s the returned buffer), a group_names DynBuf, and CharRange/REStringList dynamic arrays while parsing classes. Exec: caller supplies capture[] = lre_get_alloc_count(bc) pointers (2*captures + loop registers, 4 B each on ARM); backtracking uses an explicit StackElem array that starts as a 32-entry static_stack_buf inside the REExecContext on the C stack (128 B on ARM) and is grown x1.5 by lre_realloc when exhausted (3 words per split/alternative choice point, 2 per capture save, so it grows with text length x quantifier nesting); the VM itself is not recursive. Parser recursion per nested group: re_parse_disjunction 32 B + re_parse_alternative (term inlined) 112 B, bounded only by the lre_check_stack_overflow hook. -fstack-usage (Cortex-M4): lre_compile 264 B (REParseState incl. 128-B error/tmp buffer), lre_exec 232 B (incl. the 128-B static stack), get_class_atom 200, re_parse_captures 176, re_parse_nested_class 112. No mutable globals (data=0, bss=0), reentrant. Limits: 255 captures, 255 loop registers; timeout hook polled every 10000 goto/loop steps.
features_verified: IMPLEMENTED (read in libregexp.c re_parse_term/get_class_atom/re_parse_nested_class/lre_exec_backtrack and probed via driver): the full ES2024 RegExp grammar. Literals incl. UTF-8 in the pattern (non-BMP literals such as emoji require the u flag, otherwise 'malformed unicode char'); '.' excludes \n \r U+2028 U+2029 (matches anything with s/dotAll); ^ $ (line variants with m); escapes \d \D \s \S \w \W (\d and \w ASCII-only per ES; \s is the ES set incl. NBSP U+1680 U+2000-200A LS PS U+202F U+205F U+3000 U+FEFF), \b \B (ASCII word chars, plus U+017F/U+212A under /iu), \t \n \v \f \r, \xHH, \uHHHH, \u{...} (u), \cX, \0, legacy octal and identity escapes (Annex B, non-u only), backreferences \1..\9 and \k<name> (forward references allowed, also inside lookbehind), \p{..}/\P{..} General_Category/Script/binary/sequence properties (u; tables in libunicode.c), \q{..} string disjunctions (v). Classes [..] [^..] with ranges, class escapes inside, case-folded ranges under /i; v-mode nested classes with && and -- set operations and multi-character strings (REStringList). Quantifiers * + ? {n} {n,} {n,m}, all with lazy '?' variants; Annex-B literal '{' when not a valid quantifier (non-u); errors for nothing-to-repeat, {2,1}, unbalanced ( [ (all 7 corpus error cases rejected). Alternation |. Groups: capturing (max 255), (?:...), named (?<n>...) with duplicate names allowed in different alternatives, lookahead (?=)(?!), lookbehind (?<=)(?<!) implemented by compiling the sub-pattern in reverse direction (REOP_prev), inline modifiers (?i:..)(?-i:..)(?ims-ims:..). Flags: g (recorded only), y sticky (drops the implicit .*? scan prefix), i, m, s, u, v, d (recorded). Semantics: ES leftmost-first backtracking bytecode VM with explicit stack; empty-iteration check (REOP_check_advance/loop_check_adv) and per-iteration capture reset (REOP_save_reset) exactly per spec; case-insensitivity is Unicode canonicalization (toUpperCase-based in non-u, simple case folding in u) - ASCII-only /i does NOT exist. Input text: Latin-1 bytes (cbuf_type 0) or UTF-16 code units (1; surrogate pairs treated as one code point only when the bytecode has the u flag) - no UTF-8 text matching. Search-anywhere and captures native; lre_exec(cindex) supports lastIndex. NOT implemented: UTF-8 input, ASCII-only case folding, POSIX [:classes:], possessive/atomic groups, \A \Z \G, conditionals, recursion, any memoization/linear-time guarantee (listed as TODO in the source header).
difftest: python3 difftest.py ./engine_cli corpus_seed1.jsonl 5000 -> cases=2088 checked=2081 pass=2054 fail=27 timeouts=1 group_spans_checked=490 (10.3 s wall). The 7 expected-error cases were all rejected by lre_compile. Classification (classify.py: every failing case re-run in node v26.5.0/V8 with the same flags + 'ud'; ALL 27 engine outputs are identical to V8 -> 0 bugs, 0 missing features; everything is ES-vs-Python semantics): (1) 25 x ES empty-iteration rule + per-iteration capture reset (ES RepeatMatcher rejects a quantifier iteration that consumes nothing and clears captures inside the group at each iteration; Python keeps the empty iteration and its captures): 22 cases report a group as unset (-1 -1) or as the previous non-empty iteration where Python gives an empty span, e.g. (a*)* on 'b' -> group 1 unset vs [0,0]; ((a)|(b))+ on 'ab' -> group 2 unset vs [0,1]; 3 cases change the overall span, e.g. (|a)+ on 'aaa' -> [0,3] vs Python [0,0]. (2) 1 x case-insensitive flag is Unicode-aware: /é/i matches 'É' (lre_canonicalize) vs ASCII-only oracle expecting nomatch. (3) 1 x TIMEOUT: ^(a+)+$ on a{27}b, exponential backtracking with no memoization (V8 also exceeded the 5 s cross-check timeout). Driver's Annex-B (non-unicode) fallback parse was needed by 0 corpus patterns.
caveats: (1) Driver adaptation (driver.c, 53 lines incl. comments, plain cc): libregexp cannot match UTF-8 text, so the driver transcodes the text to UTF-16 (via cutils unicode_from_utf8), compiles with LRE_FLAG_UNICODE (retrying without it if rejected - never needed on this corpus), runs lre_exec with cbuf_type=1 (auto-upgraded to surrogate-aware 2 by the u flag), and maps capture pointers back to UTF-8 byte offsets through an index table; search-anywhere and captures are native. Passing cbuf_type=2 directly is wrong (cbuf_end = cbuf + (clen << 2)) - first driver version did that and produced garbage; fixed. lre_realloc=realloc, timeout/stack hooks return 0. (2) The headline 13334 B is libregexp.c alone; it does not link without libunicode.c + cutils.c. Cortex-M4 --gc-sections link experiments (linktest*.sh, newlib nosys): A full = text 75781 (libunicode 30600 retained + libregexp 13298 + cutils 1747 + newlib ~30 KB, mostly printf/dtoa/malloc via vsnprintf/realloc); B with the four \p{} lookups stubbed via -z muldefs = 51773; C = B + vsnprintf/realloc/abort stubbed = 23748 = libregexp 13298 + libunicode subset 6734 (case_conv tables 2006, ID_Start/ID_Continue tables 2028 used only for group-name validation, lre_ctype_bits 256, CharRange ops + canonicalize ~1.2 KB) + cutils 1747 + libc mem/str functions 1776. So a regex-only embedder pays ~22-24 KB of flash without \p{} and ~46 KB with it - 10-20x the 1-2 KB target; there is no build switch to drop \p{} (CONFIG_ALL_UNICODE is hard-defined in libunicode.h) or the v-mode string sets. (3) Case-insensitive matching is never ASCII-only; \s is the Unicode ES set. (4) No fixed-buffer/no-malloc mode: bytecode, class ranges and the backtrack stack (beyond 32 entries) all need lre_realloc. (5) Exponential backtracking is possible (^(a+)+$); the only guard is the caller's lre_check_timeout hook. (6) Semantics are the ES spec (V8-identical on every corpus mismatch), so any 'Perl/Python-style' expectation about empty iterations and repeated-group captures differs by design. (7) License MIT. (8) 36 B difference between object size (13334) and linked size (13298) is unreferenced getters (lre_get_groupnames etc.).
